capabilities: Build a timeline from dated notes
Display historical spans on an interactive timeline
Parse note dates and discover tags
extras: Most of the README covers account, credit purchase and privacy details rather than timeline usage; purchases go through Paddle in USD, and usage events and error reports are sent to external services. Requires Obsidian 1.5.0 or later.
problem: Dated notes and historical spans are hard to view in chronological order inside Obsidian.

relations.evidence: Authentication, current offers, free allowance, purchased balance and payment confirmation use the Constance v2 service
New purchases use Paddle and USD.

summary: Plugin that builds an interactive timeline from dated notes and historical spans and saves the selected timeline output.
